one_wave_grid_blocks.derivation: The source launches one identical CTA per row. Any positive grid no larger than the 132-SM hardware width is one source-identical, non-queued wave; aggregate L2 and DRAM capacity remain separate Forward bounds.

service_parameters.derivation: For each active-lane class, the grid-one cell isolates one CTA-local source round. Larger-grid clock64 captures include launch-wide cache and memory contention and therefore validate the aggregate envelope rather than defining alternate CTA-local rates. No complete production-operator duration selects either service.

clock_gate.gate: every busy nvidia-smi sample (50 ms) >= 1980 MHz; a window without busy samples requires every sample >= boost

provenance.h2560_source_note: The A800 H2560 probe source is not retained; the H200 H2560 probe is the H2048 source with kHiddenSize = 2560.
provenance.h8192_note: The A800 H8192 class was bound separately through its capture report (yaml fourth_additional_reference_sha256); on H200 it is folded into this reference as active_1024.

decision.reason: The five active-lane classes isolate the same two source phases with the probe resource signature. Forward uses only each grid-one intrinsic round service, composes it with reduction, and prices grid-dependent L2/DRAM contention through the separate aggregate resource envelope.

excluded_conclusions: rows outside the one-wave grid domain
using larger-grid validation captures as a replacement for the aggregate memory envelope
resident or queued CTA source-round service
per-shape timing interpolation or residual correction
